summary: Iter20 — Ruang Kerja Phase 1 overhaul (exports, versions, revise via workspace + chat, discuss modes, add persona, chat→doc task). BACKEND 20/21 pass (/app/backend/tests/test_oryntix_iter20.py): tasks list carries workspace_id; task detail returns has_tables(bool), version(int), versions[] without content; GET /export/docx|pdf|md → 200 with correct mimes + attachment filename; /export/xlsx → 400 when no tables, 400 for /export/bogus; POST /tasks/{id}/revise bumps version (v→v+1), old version retrievable via /versions/{v}, /versions/99 → 404; after revise with 'Tambahkan tabel anggaran…' task.has_tables flips true and /export/xlsx → 200 (ZIP magic 'PK'). Discuss: mode=chat creates private conv with task_id + 1 member, SAME cid is reused on 2nd chat call AND when mode=call (open_call=true), mode=meeting returns a SEPARATE conversation of type 'meeting' with task_id set + open_call=true. Chat-driven revision via SSE: /send 'Tolong ubah judul…' streams final content containing 'Revisi **vN**' and 'tersimpan di Ruang Kerja' and task.version increments; non-revision question 'Apa poin utama…' leaves version unchanged with a normal final reply. Add persona: POST /conversations/{cid}/personas flips type private→group, members length 2, persona_ids has both, system msg '… bergabung ke percakapan.' is inserted; duplicate persona → 409, unknown persona → 404. Member regression: budi@aivora.ai lists demo-workspace tasks, GETs them, and successfully exports docx. The ONLY failure is the chat-document → task flow: the task IS created correctly (type='document', source='chat', status='completed' with final_output + media), but the SSE final event does NOT include task_id — only media/pending_tool are forwarded by _emit_final. FRONTEND (desktop 1920x1080) all green: /workspace/{tid} shows discuss-bar (chat/call/meeting), export-bar (docx/pdf/xlsx/md) with xlsx disabled when no tables, click export-docx triggers a real file download (Proposal Magang.docx), revise-open→revise-panel→revise-submit bumps task-version badge v1→v2 and makes version-select appear; selecting v1 shows the 'Melihat v1 (lama)' amber badge. discuss-chat navigates to /chat/{cid} with task-context-card (title + 'Buka di Ruang Kerja' link visible). add-persona-btn opens add-persona-menu listing other personas; clicking one updates header subtitle to 'Chat grup · 2 asisten', inserts a 'bergabung ke percakapan' system message, and the picked persona disappears from the menu on reopen. Sending 'Tolong ubah judul bagian pertama menjadi Ringkasan Eksekutif' from chat-input via chat-send-btn produces an assistant reply containing 'Revisi' + 'tersimpan di Ruang Kerja' and the task-context-card version label updates (v2→v4 across both back-end and front-end revisions). discuss-meeting navigates to a different /chat/{meeting cid} and the meeting overlay auto-opens; rtm-leave closes it cleanly.

minor.issue: SSE final event omits task_id for chat-generated documents. tools._document_turn builds extra={media, task_id, …} and task is persisted to db.tasks correctly, but _emit_final in chat.py:482 forwards ONLY the 'media' and 'pending_tool' keys to the client payload (lines 486-488). Clients that follow the documented contract 'final event has media files and task_id' can't learn the new task_id from the stream — they would have to re-poll /api/tasks. The same bug affects revise_turn (chat.py:618) where extra={tool:'revise', task_id, task_version} is set but not emitted. Fix: in _emit_final, forward additional keys like task_id, task_version, tool, model_key (or simply payload.update({k: extra[k] for k in extra if k != 'doc_markdown'})).

action_items: Fix chat._emit_final to forward task_id (and task_version/tool) in the final SSE payload so chat-generated documents and chat-triggered revisions expose their task_id to the client. Current body of _emit_final only pulls 'media' and 'pending_tool' out of extra.
critical_code_review_comments: chat.py:482-491 _emit_final whitelists only 'media' and 'pending_tool' from extras. _document_turn and _revise_turn both put important identifiers (task_id, task_version, tool, model_label) in extras but these are stored on the DB message yet silently dropped from the SSE stream. Loosen the whitelist or forward specific extras explicitly.
workspace.py:task_access combines user_id OR workspace_id — correct for member access; tested with budi.

workspace.py:_task_personas falls back to the first workspace persona if the task has none AND persists it to the task — this is a side effect inside a GET-adjacent flow (POST /discuss); reasonable but worth noting for audit.
tools.has_tables requires ≥2 TABLE_RE matches (header + ≥1 body row), which is correct; a single-row markdown table would be rejected. OK since valid tables need header + separator + body.

chat.py:_wants_revision only fires when ctx.task is set (conv.task_id present). Chat-document creation (which also writes to db.tasks) does NOT set conv.task_id on the originating conversation, so subsequent revision-style messages in that same chat will NOT auto-revise the just-created task. If that is desired, consider setting conv.task_id after _document_turn.

TaskDetail.jsx version-select rendering uses `allVersions = [...task.versions.map(v=>v.version), task.version]`; works but doesn't sort. If versions ever come back unordered this would surface stale ordering.
seed_data_creation: Reused existing completed task c123748e… / its clone. Created 1 new chat-generated document task 'Proposal Magang' (task 1f6af7fd…), a new private conversation (becomes task-discussion via /discuss), one group conversation (private + added persona), and a new meeting conversation seeded from /discuss?mode=meeting. All in demo's workspace; no destructive changes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_oryntix_iter20.py -o addopts='' -v` (~35s). Only TestChatDocumentCreatesTask::test_document_chat_creates_task fails and it is a REAL backend bug (SSE final event drops task_id for chat-document and chat-revision flows) — fix in backend/chat.py:_emit_final by forwarding task_id/task_version. Frontend selectors verified: workspace detail uses data-testid=discuss-{chat|call|meeting}, export-{docx|pdf|xlsx|md}, revise-open/panel/input/submit, task-version, version-select; Chat uses task-context-card/-title/-open, add-persona-btn/-menu/-{pid}, chat-input, chat-send-btn, rtm-leave for the realtime meeting overlay. Revise LLM takes 10-40s — use ≥60s timeout. If 429 brute-force limits trip during repeated logins, `sudo supervisorctl restart backend` resets the in-memory deque.
rca of the issue: Chat-document task_id missing from SSE: _document_turn builds `extra = {media, tool, model_key, model_label, doc_markdown, task_id: task['id']}` and passes it to `_emit_final(ctx, text, credits, extra)`. _emit_final persists the AI message to Mongo with full extra via _save_ai_msg (so the DB message HAS task_id), but when yielding the SSE event it only copies two keys: `for k in ('media','pending_tool'): if k in extra: payload[k] = extra[k]`. Everything else — task_id, task_version, tool, model_label — is dropped from the client-facing stream. Fix: either loosen the whitelist to a sensible set like `('media','pending_tool','task_id','task_version','tool','model_label')` or forward every key except the heavy `doc_markdown` payload. Reproduction: POST /api/conversations/{cid}/send with content 'Buatkan dokumen proposal …' and read SSE; the final event has media[] but no task_id even though a new task row with type='document' + source='chat' appears in db.tasks.
